_comment: USER 2026-11-19: 'Otherwise it should be untapped in goldfish.' The control for spirits_human_shock_tapped_when_unusable: the same lone land drop, but the board's other land is a Plains, so Usher of the Fallen's boast {1}{W} -- legal only AFTER it attacks, i.e. later than this pre-combat segment -- is payable with the Grave untapped. The human-play default pays the 2 life (life 18) even though the segment itself casts nothing (the pre-2026-11-19 rule entered it tapped). The boast itself is the human's call (the scenario passes the post-combat main), so only the entry is asserted.
